item.text:
Added view transitions to the product gallery. The selected product’s image now shares a transition name between the grid and detail page, so it can morph between the two sizes. Forward navigation slides left, and the back link slides right. Suspense content fades in as skeletons resolve, with view transition styling for the swap.

The CSS disables these animations, including the skeleton pulse, when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is set. See [the grid](/workspace/app/ProductGrid.tsx:9), [the detail page](/workspace/app/product/[slug]/page.tsx:39), and [the transition styles](/workspace/app/globals.css:113).

`npm run build` passes. I also checked that the grid and detail routes render and that an unknown product returns 404. I could not visually verify the motion in a browser in this environment.
